newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Port conditions update - Sri Lanka - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Port conditions update - Sri Lanka - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
Sri Lanka, Dec 27 - Colombo - Leading port unions have called a one day token strike today in protest of the government's leasing of the Queen Elizabeth quay to the Pando consortium.

Port operations and allied services have been disrupted. Meanwhile ministry officials including the minister of shipping, ports, rehabilitation and reconstruction have called for a meeting of all unions in the Colombo port to discuss matters concerning this issue.
